InstallationUsage guide

Getting started with the library

This guide explains how to install the package and write your first program.

Installation

Run the following command in your terminal:

npm install example-package --save

Then import the createClient function into your project.

OptionDescription
timeoutMaximum waiting time in seconds
retriesHow many times to repeat a failed request

Usage guide

  • Create a client with your settings.
  • Send a request and wait for the answer.
